notes: Mobile Harness Code v1.19.6 — optional central GROM server connection. A single "Connect GROM Server" switch (OFF by default) in Settings adds connect discovery, API compatibility checks, scoped password/Ed25519 authentication, service listing and a Free LLM API bridge. Free LLM API over Grom honestly reports "not available" until a Grom service publishes the llm.proxy capability (Grom v0.16.0 ships only the agent and lightning services). Existing agents, providers, RuntimeBridge and Standard Mode are unchanged. Signed (V2) with the unchanged production certificate.
